newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Uneximbank mulls sale of 34 pct SIDANKO oil group.
newsitem.headline: Uneximbank mulls sale of 34 pct SIDANKO oil group.

text.p: Russian bank Uneximbank is considering the sale of 34 percent of oil group SIDANKO as a means of attracting investment in the oil company, a senior source at Uneximbank said on Wednesday.

"We are considering selling a 34 percent share as a means of attracting investment, but we intend to keep 51 percent (of the shares) to maintain full control of the company," the source, who declined to be identified, said.
The 34 percent share in SIDANKO was used by Interros-Oil, part of an industrial group built around Uneximbank, as collateral in a loan from Cyprus-registered Kantupun Holding Company Ltd.
The Uneximbank source said the bank had yet to decide on whether the sale would be to strategic or portfolio investors, and gave no likely timeframe for the possible sale.

SIDANKO is Russia's fifth or sixth largest oil group in terms of production. SIDANKO produced 20.81 million tonnes (416,000 barrels per day) of oil and gas condesnate in 1996, down from 22.87 million (457,000 bpd) in 1995.
SIDANKO units include Kondpetroleum, Varyoganneftegaz and Chernogorneft.
